svg.text: Original photo preserved. Wires indicate electrical routes; amber callouts have no assigned pin contacts.
OCTOPUS + PI + RELIABOT / YOUR ACTUAL ASSEMBLY
Kit PSU -> Pi USB-C power input.
EBB also needs 24 V and GND.
Both connect to the 24 V distribution.
Return goes to BED-OUT -, not DC GND.
Routes stop beside the plug; follow wires.
First three terminal pairs: MOTOR-POWER, POWER, BED-POWER. Each receives +24 V and DC GND.
Use suitable DC distribution, wire sizes and branch protection; those selections remain to be finalized.
Blue heater callouts indicate the output pair only. Follow the module markings when assigning individual poles.
Preserve stock protective earth. This drawing does not alter mains wiring. Electrical checks remain pending.
